Group rides in Minnesota

11 recurring group rides around Minnesota: 7 social, 6 road, 2 mountain bike. 8 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Bonesaw Cycling Collective Summer Tuesday Ride in Minneapolis — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Freewheel MPLS Wednesday Night Ride runs 15–17 mph average.

I do the miles. You decide who they’re for.
